entries.title: Wait event: buffer busy waits
entries.summary: A session wanted a buffer that another session was reading or changing; look at which block class and segment is hot.

entries.title: Wait event: free buffer waits
entries.summary: The cache had no clean buffer to give; usually a sign that writing is slower than reading or that the cache is too small.

entries.title: Wait event: write complete waits
entries.summary: A session needed a buffer that is currently being written to disk and had to wait for the write to finish.

entries.title: Wait event: read by other session
entries.summary: Several sessions wanted the same block; one reads it from disk, the others wait for that read.

entries.title: Wait event: buffer deadlock
entries.summary: Reported when buffer requests collide and one session must retry.

entries.title: Wait event: db file sequential read
entries.summary: A single-block physical read, typical for index and rowid access; average latency tells you about the storage.

entries.title: Wait event: db file scattered read
entries.summary: A multiblock read into the buffer cache, typical of full scans.

entries.title: Wait event: db file parallel read
entries.summary: Several blocks read concurrently, for example in prefetch or recovery.

entries.title: Wait event: db file parallel write
entries.summary: Database writer waits for a batch of datafile writes to complete.

entries.title: Wait event: db file single write
entries.summary: A single-block datafile write, such as updating file headers.

entries.title: Wait event: db file async I/O submit
entries.summary: Time spent handing asynchronous I/O requests to the operating system.

entries.title: Wait event: direct path read
entries.summary: Reads that skip the buffer cache, as for parallel scans, large serial scans and temp access.

entries.title: Wait event: direct path write
entries.summary: Writes that skip the buffer cache, such as direct loads and spills to temp.

entries.title: Wait event: direct path sync
entries.summary: Waiting for data written directly to be flushed to disk.

entries.title: Wait event: Disk file operations I/O
entries.summary: File operations such as open, close or resize, not data transfer.

entries.title: Wait event: control file parallel write
entries.summary: Waiting for writes to all copies of the control file.

entries.title: Wait event: control file sequential read
entries.summary: Reading the control file one block at a time.

entries.title: Wait event: control file single write
entries.summary: Writing a single control file block.

entries.title: Wait event: log file sync
entries.summary: A committing session waits for the log writer to persist its redo; divides into LGWR I/O time and scheduling delay.

entries.title: Wait event: log file parallel write
entries.summary: Time the log writer waits for redo writes to all members of a group to complete.

entries.title: Wait event: log file sequential read
entries.summary: Reading redo sequentially, for example by the archiver or recovery.

entries.title: Wait event: log file single write
entries.summary: Writing the redo log header, for example at a switch.

entries.title: Wait event: log buffer space
entries.summary: Sessions wait for space in the redo buffer because redo is generated faster than it is written.

entries.title: Wait event: log file switch completion
entries.summary: Waiting for a log switch to finish before more redo can be written.

entries.title: Wait event: log file switch (checkpoint incomplete)
entries.summary: The next redo log cannot be reused because the checkpoint for it has not finished.

entries.title: Wait event: log file switch (archiving needed)
entries.summary: The next redo log cannot be reused until it is archived.

entries.title: Wait event: log file switch (private strand flush incomplete)
entries.section: log file switch (private strand flush incomplete)
keywords: log file switch (private strand flush incomplete)
entries.summary: A switch waits for private redo strands to be flushed.

entries.title: Wait event: log switch/archive
entries.summary: A session waits while a log switch and archive is carried out.

entries.title: Wait event: checkpoint completed
entries.summary: A session waits for a requested checkpoint to complete.

entries.title: Wait event: enqueue
entries.summary: Generic enqueue wait; the event name (in later releases) or P1 shows the lock type.

entries.title: Wait event: enq: TX - row lock contention
entries.summary: A session wants a row that another open transaction has changed and waits until that transaction ends.

entries.title: Wait event: enq: TX - index contention
entries.summary: Waiting while another session splits an index block.

entries.title: Wait event: index block split
entries.summary: Waiting for an index block split to finish.

entries.title: Wait event: enq: SV - contention
entries.summary: Contention on a sequence value cache.

entries.title: Wait event: library cache lock
entries.summary: Waiting for a lock on an object definition in the library cache.

entries.title: Wait event: library cache pin
entries.summary: Waiting to pin an object that someone else holds in an incompatible mode.

entries.title: Wait event: library cache load lock
entries.summary: Waiting for an object to be loaded into the library cache.

entries.title: Wait event: library cache: mutex X
entries.summary: Exclusive library cache mutex held while a cursor structure is changed, commonly during parsing storms.

entries.title: Wait event: cursor: mutex S
entries.summary: Contention on the shared cursor mutex, often with heavy parsing.

entries.title: Wait event: cursor: mutex X
entries.summary: Exclusive cursor mutex wait, often during hard parses.

entries.title: Wait event: cursor: pin S
entries.summary: Waiting for a shared pin on a cursor.

entries.title: Wait event: cursor: pin S wait on X
entries.section: cursor: pin S wait on X
keywords: cursor: pin S wait on X
entries.summary: Waiting for shared pin while another session holds it exclusively, typically a hard parse of the same SQL.

entries.title: Wait event: cursor: pin X
entries.summary: Waiting for an exclusive pin on a cursor.

entries.title: Wait event: latch free
entries.summary: A session could not get a latch and slept; the latch name identifies the structure.

entries.title: Wait event: latch: redo copy
entries.summary: Contention while copying redo into the log buffer.

entries.title: Wait event: latch: row cache objects
entries.summary: Contention on the latch protecting the dictionary cache.

entries.title: Wait event: row cache lock
entries.summary: Waiting for a dictionary cache lock, for example on sequences without enough cache.

entries.title: Wait event: rdbms ipc reply
entries.summary: A foreground waits for a reply from a background process.

entries.title: Wait event: rdbms ipc message (idle)
entries.summary: An idle wait of background processes waiting for work.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net message from client
entries.summary: Server waits for the next client request; mostly idle, but large averages can reflect slow clients or networks.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net message to client
entries.summary: Time to send a response to the client.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net more data from client
entries.summary: The server waits for more of a large request from the client.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net more data to client
entries.summary: The server sends results in several pieces; high values hint at large result sets.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net message from dblink
entries.summary: Waiting for a remote database over a database link.

entries.title: Wait event: SQL*Net break/reset to client
entries.summary: Client-side error or cancellation handling.

entries.title: Wait event: virtual circuit wait
entries.summary: Shared-server session waiting for a response.

entries.title: Wait event: shared server idle wait
entries.summary: Shared server process waiting for work.

entries.title: Wait event: undo segment extension
entries.summary: Undo segment is growing, which can slow transactions.

entries.title: Wait event: undo segment tx slot
entries.summary: Waiting for a free slot in an undo segment header.

entries.title: Wait event: transaction
entries.summary: Waiting on a transaction that holds a needed resource.

entries.title: Wait event: resmgr:cpu quantum
entries.summary: Session is throttled because its consumer group used up its CPU allocation.

entries.title: Wait event: resmgr:become active
entries.summary: Session queued by an active-session limit.

entries.title: Wait event: resmgr:pq queued
entries.summary: Parallel statement queued by Resource Manager.

entries.title: Wait event: resmgr: I/O rate limit
entries.summary: Session is throttled by an I/O limit.

entries.title: Wait event: PX Deque wait
entries.summary: Parallel slave or coordinator waiting for the next message.

entries.title: Wait event: PX qref latch
entries.summary: Contention on parallel execution message queues.

entries.title: Wait event: PL/SQL lock timer
entries.summary: Session is intentionally sleeping through DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP.

entries.title: Wait event: pipe get
entries.summary: Waiting for a message on a pipe.

entries.title: Wait event: utl_file I/O
entries.summary: Waiting on file operations done through UTL_FILE.

entries.title: Wait event: TCP Socket (KGAS)
entries.summary: Waiting on network calls made from PL/SQL.

entries.title: Wait event: Streams AQ waiting for messages
entries.section: Streams AQ: waiting for messages in the
keywords: Streams AQ: waiting for messages in the
entries.summary: Advanced Queuing waits for messages (an idle-style wait).

entries.title: Wait event: smon timer
entries.summary: SMON sleeping between work.

entries.title: Wait event: pmon timer
entries.summary: PMON sleeping between work.

entries.title: Wait event: ASYNC Remote Write
entries.summary: Redo transport waiting for an asynchronous remote write.

entries.title: Wait event: SYNC Remote Write
entries.summary: Redo transport waiting for a synchronous remote write; adds to commit time.

entries.title: Wait event: flashback log file sync
entries.summary: Waiting for flashback log writes at commit.

entries.title: Wait event: inactive session
entries.summary: A killed session waits for its resources to be cleaned up.

entries.title: Wait event: optimizer stats update retry
entries.summary: Retry while updating optimizer statistics.

entries.title: Wait event: dispatcher timer
entries.summary: Dispatcher waiting for work.

entries.title: Wait event: gc buffer busy acquire
entries.summary: Another session on this instance is already requesting the same remote block, so this one waits.

entries.title: Wait event: gc buffer busy release
entries.summary: Block is busy because a request on another instance is being served.

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr block 2-way
entries.summary: A consistent-read block arrived from another instance directly (two messages).

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr block 3-way
entries.summary: A consistent-read block came via the master instance (three messages).

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr block busy
entries.summary: The CR block was delayed because the holder was busy, for example flushing redo.

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr block congested
entries.summary: The serving LMS process was too busy to answer quickly.

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr block lost
entries.summary: A requested block was lost on the interconnect; points to network trouble.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current block 2-way
entries.summary: A current-mode block arrived directly from the holder instance.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current block 3-way
entries.summary: A current-mode block arrived via the master instance.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current block busy
entries.summary: The holder was busy, often flushing redo before sending.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current block congested
entries.summary: Serving LMS was too busy to respond quickly.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current block lost
entries.summary: A current block was lost on the interconnect.

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr request
entries.summary: Generic wait for a consistent-read block from the cluster.

entries.title: Wait event: gc current request
entries.summary: Generic wait for a current block from the cluster.

entries.title: Wait event: gc cr multi block mixed
entries.summary: Multiblock request in the cluster answered with a mixture of grants and blocks.

entries.title: Wait event: gc index operation
entries.summary: Global cache wait during an index operation such as a split.

entries.title: DB_CACHE_SIZE (initialization parameter)

entries.title: OPTIMIZER_INDEX_COST_ADJ (initialization parameter)

entries.title: OPTIMIZER_USE_SQL_PLAN_BASELINES (initialization parameter)

entries.title: PARALLEL_SERVERS_TARGET (initialization parameter)

entries.title: STATISTICS_LEVEL (initialization parameter)
